goal: Add a bounded set of mainstream, source-backed Arduino board profiles without regressing the existing skill package.

primary_metric.name: source_backed_board_profiles
primary_metric.threshold: at least four new profiles pass every board-reference gate

correctness_gates: protected existing board profile hashes remain unchanged
every added profile has at least two authoritative source URLs, fact mapping, and explicit gaps
hard_constraints: Preserve all five existing board profiles and their source claims.
Keep raw ordered constexpr int declarations and C/C++ embedded-first guidance unchanged.
Use official primary sources for board and MCU facts; mark mutable or inaccessible sources.
Do not claim compile, upload, power, hardware, system, or deployment success.
Do not weaken or modify an evaluator merely to accept a candidate.
Do not add secrets, undeclared dependencies, or host-specific duplicated skill content.

results: all existing structural, plugin, contract, and forward evals pass

per_iteration_budget: one cohesive research or repository patch followed by targeted validation
evaluation_method: scripts/validate_board_references.py plus existing structural, plugin, contract, forward, link, and hash checks
acceptance_rule: Keep a candidate only if the primary metric reaches at least 9 profiles, every correctness gate passes, and protected hashes remain unchanged.
rollback_method: Restore only the board-expansion experiment surface with an explicit reverse patch after inspecting git diff; preserve prior user changes and rerun the baseline gates.
plateau_rule: Stop after two consecutive candidate sets are deferred for source gaps or fail to increase the verified profile count.
stop_conditions: A candidate lacks two authoritative sources for its required facts.
A board profile conflicts with an existing exact-board claim and cannot be reconciled without guessing.
Any protected existing profile hash changes unexpectedly.
A validation repair would weaken evaluator coverage.
Physical hardware evidence is requested but unavailable.

experiment_history.result: 5 board profiles and all existing deterministic gates pass
9 profiles; board validator, Python syntax, and diff checks pass
Plugin, skill, contract, forward-eval, host manifest, JSON, source status, link, syntax, diff, and protected-profile hash gates pass

9 profiles; 28 skills; 8/8 contract themes; 10/10 forward evals; official plugin validator pass; 14/14 added sources HTTP 200; 5/5 protected hashes pass; independent artifact unavailable and recorded as conditional

open_uncertainties: Arduino product pages remain mutable date-checked sources rather than immutable revisions.
Exact module, board revision, partition, regulator, aggregate current, and clone/carrier behavior remain board-specific.
Board-level aggregate current and clone/carrier behavior are not inferable from MCU limits.
